items.summary: ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) is expanding partnerships to roll out agentic AI and large-scale AI workflows across enterprise customers. Companies such as KORE and Keysight are choosing the ServiceNow platform to support next-generation customer experience and efficiency solutions. items.title: Datadog Just Dropped 34% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock fell 34% in a week, first in a software selloff that also hit ServiceNow and Cloudflare, then on a flat fourth-quarter outlook. That outlook assumes Datadog’s largest customer, an AI company, pays only its minimum; growth from everyone else is guided to the low to mid-30s.

items.title: Arista Networks vs. ServiceNow: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: Arista's near-zero debt and 39% net margin stand in sharp contrast to ServiceNow's cheaper valuation, and the gap between them may decide which stock deserves your capital.

items.title: Palantir Just Had Its Best Growth Quarter Ever. Why Are Investors Selling?
items.summary: Palantir just posted the fastest revenue growth in its public company history, yet investors are selling the stock. Understanding what spooked the market reveals a tension between two very different stories buried inside the same earnings report.
